prompt:
A line-art multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 4 columns and 4 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 14 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a clean, simple line drawing: uniform thin black outlines on a plain white background, with no shading, hatching, grey tones, colour or texture. Each panel has a thin black border, with plain white gutters between the panels. Location: The Quinn family mansion, living room, Day, bright daylight through the arched French windows, warm chandelier fill.
Image 1: the character sheet of Natalie (25), look S0
Image 2: the character sheet of Cassie (23), look S0
Image 3: the character sheet of George (55), look S0
Image 4: the character sheet of Lauren (50), look S0
Image 5: the location The Quinn family mansion, living room, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, with no people
Image 6: the location The Quinn family mansion, living room, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 7: the location The Quinn family mansion, living room, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 8: the location The Quinn family mansion, living room, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, with no people
Image 9: the location The Quinn family mansion, living room, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, with no people
Image 10: the blocking reference of this segment, the same place with its people in their places at the start; use it only for where each person is and which way they face, and keep each person on that seat or spot, on the same side of the room, in every panel until a shot moves them; do not copy its colours or light
Image 11: the prop hospital statement; use only structure, material, and color
Draw each character so they can be told apart as in their reference image: the hairstyle, build and outfit in outline. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the layout of the space and the place of its furniture and props, drawn in outline. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: Axis: the line from the single cream armchair to the long cream sofa. The camera stays on the front (bookshelf) wall side and looks toward the three tall arched French windows on the back wall; reverse singles on Natalie look toward the bookshelf wall. The one long cream sofa runs across the frame in front of the windows and faces the camera. The white marble fireplace is on the left wall at frame left. The open white double doorway is on the right wall at frame right. The one single cream armchair stands in the foreground centre with its back to the camera, facing the sofa across the one low glass-and-gold coffee table, which now stands empty. Natalie stands beside the armchair on its doorway (frame-right) side, facing the sofa, holding the hospital statement at her side. Cassie stands next to her, nearer the doorway, facing her with a smirk. George sits at the fireplace end of the sofa, frame left, looking up. Lauren sits at the doorway end of the sofa, frame right, at the same depth as George, smiling.
Panel 1: Medium shot from the front, dirty single on Cassie with Natalie's shoulder at the frame-left edge. Cassie folds her arms and nods.
Panel 2: Medium close-up, low angle, clean single on Cassie, slow push in. Only Cassie, framed on her face and shoulders; she wrinkles her nose in disgust and flicks her hair over her shoulder.
Panel 3: Medium shot, reverse clean single on Natalie looking toward the bookshelf wall, locked-off camera. Only Natalie; her fingers tighten on the hospital statement as she stares at Cassie, who is off screen beside her toward the doorway.
Panel 4: Medium shot, two-shot of the sofa from the front. Lauren at frame right nods firmly beside George at frame left.
Panel 5: Medium shot from the front, slight high angle, dirty single on Lauren with George's shoulder at the frame-left edge. Lauren turns left to George and pats his knee.
Panel 6: Close-up from the front, clean single on Lauren. Only Lauren, framed tight on her face; she looks back toward Natalie with a thin mauve-lipped smile.
Panel 7: Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot past Cassie's shoulder, from the front. Natalie shakes her head and takes a step back against the frame-right side of the armchair.
Panel 8: Medium shot, low angle, dirty single on Cassie with Natalie's arm at the frame-left edge. Cassie leans left toward Natalie and taps the hospital statement in Natalie's hand with one fingernail.
Panel 9: Medium close-up from the front, clean single on George. Only George, framed on his face and shoulders; he looks down at his hands and stays silent.
Panel 10: Medium shot from the front, dirty single on Lauren with George's shoulder at the frame-left edge. Lauren crosses her legs and raises her eyebrows at Natalie, waiting.
Panel 11: Medium shot, handheld, reverse single on Natalie standing by the armchair, looking toward the bookshelf wall. Natalie closes her eyes and her hand crumples the edge of the hospital statement.
Panel 12: Close-up, reverse clean single, slow push in on Natalie's face. Only Natalie, framed tight on her face; she opens her eyes and lifts her chin, her gaze steady.
Panel 13: Close-up, low angle, clean single on Cassie. Only Cassie, framed tight on her face; she smirks and twirls a gold hoop earring.
Panel 14: Medium shot, two-shot of the sofa from the front, slow pull out. Lauren at frame right smiles in satisfaction on the sofa while George at frame left keeps his eyes lowered beside her.
Keep the characters, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no photographic rendering, shading or colour.
